```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
tier_order <- c("Power", "Group of 5", "FCS and below")
credited <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(season >= first_season, season <= last_season) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(tier_label = factor(tier_label, levels = tier_order))
team_season <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(classification == "fbs", season <= last_season) |>
  collect()
teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |> collect()
team_colors <- team_color_values(teams)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
fbs_cr <- credited |>
  filter(tier_label != "FCS and below") |>
  mutate(
    league = case_when(
      conference == "FBS Independents" & team == "Notre Dame" ~ "Notre Dame",
      conference == "FBS Independents" ~ "Other FBS independents",
      .default = conference
    )
  )
fbs_pos <- fbs_cr |>
  filter(position_group != "Position not recorded")
pos_rate <- draft_rates(group_by(fbs_pos, position_group)) |>
  select(position_group, pos_rate = draft_rate)
pos_tier_rate <- draft_rates(group_by(fbs_pos, position_group, tier_label)) |>
  select(position_group, tier_label, tier_pos_rate = draft_rate)
# Each school's expected draftees: its eligible players times the FBS-wide
# rate at each position, and times its own tier's rate at each position.
school_pos <- fbs_pos |>
  left_join(pos_tier_rate, by = c("position_group", "tier_label")) |>
  group_by(team, position_group) |>
  summarise(
    eligible = sum(n_eligible),
    drafted = sum(n_drafted),
    expected_tier = sum(n_eligible * tier_pos_rate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(pos_rate, by = "position_group") |>
  mutate(expected = eligible * pos_rate)
conf_now <- team_season |>
  group_by(team) |>
  slice_max(season, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(team, conf_now = if_else(conference == "FBS Independents", "FBS independents", conference))
school_tier <- fbs_cr |>
  count(team, tier_label, wt = n_eligible) |>
  group_by(team) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(team, school_tier = tier_label)
school <- school_pos |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarise(
    eligible = sum(eligible),
    drafted = sum(drafted),
    expected = sum(expected),
    expected_tier = sum(expected_tier),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    above = drafted - expected,
    above_tier = drafted - expected_tier,
    draft_rate = drafted / eligible
  ) |>
  left_join(conf_now, by = "team") |>
  left_join(school_tier, by = "team") |>
  mutate(adjusted = shrink_rate(drafted, eligible, group = conf_now)) |>
  arrange(desc(above))
bama <- filter(school, team == "Alabama")
g5 <- filter(school, school_tier == "Group of 5")
g5_best <- slice_max(g5, above_tier, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
n_g5_above_tier <- sum(g5$above_tier > 0)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
top_fbs <- slice_head(school, n = 10) |>
  mutate(highlight = if_else(team == "Alabama", team, "Other"))
p <- ggplot(top_fbs, aes(above, reorder(team, above), fill = highlight)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        team, ": ", drafted, " drafted of ", fmt(eligible), " eligible; ",
        fmt(expected, 1), " expected, ", fmt(above, 1), " above"
      ),
      data_id = team
    ),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Alabama" = team_colors[["Alabama"]], "Other" = "grey65"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(
    title = "Draftees above expected, by FBS school",
    subtitle = "Schools furthest above the FBS-wide expectation; Alabama in its team color",
    x = "Draftees above expected",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "schools-above-expected-draftees", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
bind_rows(
  slice_head(school, n = 10),
  g5 |> arrange(desc(above_tier)) |> slice_head(n = 5)
) |>
  transmute(
    School = team,
    Tier = school_tier,
    Eligible = fmt(eligible),
    Drafted = drafted,
    `Out of 100 eligible, drafted` = round(100 * draft_rate),
    `Expected, FBS average` = fmt(expected, 1),
    `Above FBS average` = fmt(above, 1),
    `Expected, own tier` = fmt(expected_tier, 1),
    `Above own tier` = fmt(above_tier, 1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "School", "Tier", "Eligible players", "Drafted", "Out of 100 eligible, drafted",
      "Expected, FBS average", "Above FBS average", "Expected, own tier", "Above own tier"
    ),
    caption = "The 10 FBS schools furthest above the FBS-wide expectation, then the 5 Group of 5 schools furthest above their own tier's expectation. Expected draftees multiply each position's draft rate (FBS-wide, or the tier's rate in each player's final season) by the school's eligible players there. A school's tier is the one most of its eligible players finished in."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: dots
conf_avg <- school |>
  group_by(conf_now) |>
  summarise(avg = sum(drafted) / sum(eligible), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(avg) |>
  mutate(conf_now = factor(conf_now, levels = conf_now))
dots <- school |>
  mutate(
    conf_now = factor(conf_now, levels = levels(conf_avg$conf_now)),
    tip = paste0(
      team, " (", conf_now, ")\n", drafted, " drafted of ", eligible,
      " eligible; adjusted rate ", pct(adjusted)
    )
  )
p_dots <- ggplot(dots, aes(adjusted, conf_now)) +
  geom_point(
    data = conf_avg,
    aes(avg, conf_now),
    shape = 124,
    size = 12,
    color = "#111827"
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = team),
    size = 3.6,
    color = "grey65",
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 0.47)) +
  labs(
    x = "Adjusted draft rate",
    y = "Conference, most recent season",
    title = "Every FBS school against its conference's average",
    subtitle = "Black tick: conference average; hover a dot for the school and its adjusted rate",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_dots)
```
